what_this_is: The share of nights whose completion did not parse, counted from every cell as it FIRST ran - held cells included, since their cell_HELD_FOR_REVIEW.json is the original run's record. Recorded in a file rather than computed at report time because two of these cells are being rerun: rerunning until it parses and then reporting the clean run is selection on outcome unless the original failure is reported as a number.
the_comparison: MemGPT as published: 2 of 96 nights, 2.1%. Every other arm that makes a nightly call: 0 of 1,920. `last seen, no model` makes no nightly call at all and is excluded from that denominator rather than counted as 640 clean nights.
what_it_suggests: Both failures are in the one arm that asks the model to edit a 20,000-character block by quoting substrings of it, and the same three cells quoted a piece of the block that was not there 9, 7 and 3 times. A malformed completion on one night in fifty reads as a property of that editing interface rather than of the model.
the_accuracy_numbers_for_this_arm: come from RERUNS of MemGPT as published / hh_s32_t03 and hh_s48_t03. The original runs are kept under superseded_the_night_that_did_not_parse_2026-09-25/. If a rerun fails to parse on the same night, that is reported instead of rerun again: two failures on one night would make it a property of that night's prompt rather than noise.
